title: A steep phase-noise slope can suggest flicker up-conversion
summary: A steep phase-noise slope can suggest flicker up-conversion. Source decomposition at the failing offset is needed to identify its origin.
actions: Inspect absolute noise contributions and operating conditions.
Consider tail filtering and legal device sizing; remeasure all required offsets.

title: A thermal-noise-like slope motivates checking tank energy, loss and core noise
summary: A thermal-noise-like slope motivates checking tank energy, loss and core noise. Slope alone does not establish a unique mechanism.
actions: Check available power, swing and effective tank Q.

title: Off-state switches and their bias networks may load the tank and lower swing at some codes
summary: Off-state switches and their bias networks may load the tank and lower swing at some codes.
actions: Measure the full biased bank admittance.
Check legal bias resistance and switch geometry using your binding.

title: A periodic solver can fail when its initial frequency guess is far from the oscillating mode
summary: A periodic solver can fail when its initial frequency guess is far from the oscillating mode.
actions: Probe startup frequency or update the guess before changing geometry.

title: Geometry outside a user model domain must be corrected before interpreting a solver failure as a circuit limit
summary: Geometry outside a user model domain must be corrected before interpreting a solver failure as a circuit limit.
actions: Read the instance and model diagnostic.
Use explicit binding limits; do not invent missing technology rules.

title: Insufficient startup gain, excessive tank loading or selection of a DC solution can prevent oscillation
summary: Insufficient startup gain, excessive tank loading or selection of a DC solution can prevent oscillation.
actions: Inspect startup, loss, bias and modal excitation.

title: A timeout is an execution failure, rather than proof of electrical infeasibility
summary: A timeout is an execution failure, rather than proof of electrical infeasibility.
actions: Check solver progress and frequency guess.
Retain the timeout receipt before retrying with a bounded budget.

title: For an ideal LC resonance, f is proportional to 1/sqrt(LC)
summary: For an ideal LC resonance, f is proportional to 1/sqrt(LC). Fixed and parasitic capacitance require remeasurement after scaling.

title: Total power includes supply, bias and control sources
summary: Total power includes supply, bias and control sources. The useful power knob follows the actual bias topology.
actions: Check each source current and its voltage.
Remeasure frequency and phase noise after changing bias.

title: Periodic convergence alone does not prove startup or transient steady state
summary: Periodic convergence alone does not prove startup or transient steady state.
actions: Save a startup waveform and inspect its envelope.
Keep unresolved warnings in the result qualification.
